description: Track V ingest web-source roster — the machine-readable half of .claude/skills/ingest-newsletters/SKILL.md (policy stays in the skill; URLs + fetch mechanics live here). Driven by scripts/fetch-sources.mjs, which snapshots each source and emits .ingest-cache/changes.json so the ingest only spends model attention on sources that actually changed. fetch: "auto" = plain HTTP first, headless-browser fallback; "browser" = known to 403/JS-wall plain fetches. cadence: "monthly" sources are checked on the first Monday run of the month only.

sources.name: Brooklyn Craft Company
sources.notes: 165 Greenpoint Ave; workshops sell out fast — note availability on cards. NEWSLETTER IS PRIMARY (info@brooklyncraftcompany.com, in senderRegistry) — the Shopify collection page hides dated listings (2026-07-25 lesson). VENUE IS NOT STATED PER DATE (2026-08-03 lesson, PR #18): the newsletter lists a class's dates then says "In Greenpoint and Lower Manhattan" — it never says which date is where, and BCC runs a concurrent Lower Manhattan pop-up (225 Broadway). NEVER pin a newsletter workshop at 165 Greenpoint Ave on the newsletter alone. The per-session location lives in a BookThatApp widget that is unreadable by automation — verified three ways: invisible to WebFetch ("Date & Time: select above"), does not render headless (a control on a known-live session shows the same empty "Notify Me" state), and absent from Shopify's product JSON (single Default Title variant). Resolving a date needs a human in a real browser or an email to BCC — so these go to watchItems, not to a weekly re-author.

sources.name: Last Place on Earth
sources.notes: 531 Graham Ave, Brooklyn NY 11222 (Greenpoint zip); board game shop + community hub — D&D nights across the week, murder mysteries, one-shots, kids' afterschool. Owner-operated by Whitney Wolfe; sister space '3rd Place from the Sun' still upcoming, so single location as of the 2026-07-25 snapshot. Not a bar and not a coffee shop; outside food/drink allowed, $20 corking fee. Batu 2026-07-27: point at /events, not the homepage — the homepage snapshot carries the about/FAQ/address but NO dated listings, which is exactly why. One of the three game-club sources to keep in every scan. The /events URL itself is NOT YET FETCHED (network allowlist) — confirm it carries dated listings on the first successful fetch. CHANNEL: email is NOT viable — owner Whitney replied to Batu 2026-07-22 from lastplaceonearthbk@gmail.com, 'We haven't done a newsletter in a while. Honestly, we update things mostly on discord.' So /events is the primary source and their Discord is where the schedule actually lives; if /events proves thin, Discord is the gap-filler to raise with Batu (it needs an invite, not a scrape).

sources.name: The Carcosa Club
sources.notes: 982 Manhattan Ave, Brooklyn NY 11222; hours Sun-Thu 9am-11pm, Fri-Sat 9am-midnight (both per the 2026-07-25 snapshot). Membership waitlist-only but $15/day guest passes + public events. Ignore stale aggregator listings at the closed Williamsburg address. Batu 2026-07-27: one of the three game-club sources to keep in every scan. MONTH-BOUNDARY GAP: the events page renders ONE month grid — the current one — so near month end the Aug 1-6 half of our today+10 window is invisible. Batu's link pinned &month=07-2026; the param is dropped here so the scan follows the current month rather than going stale, but when a run falls within ~10 days of month end, ALSO fetch &month=MM-YYYY for the following month or those events are silently missed. Batu confirmed 2026-08 has events at &month=08-2026. CHANNEL: web-only — a broad Gmail search on 2026-07-27 found no Carcosa newsletter in the mailbox at all, so nothing here arrives by email.

sources.name: New York Society of Play
sources.notes: Third game-club source (Batu 2026-07-27). RESOLVED 2026-07-27 run 2: nyplays.org/events/ is nav-only chrome — the real schedule is a Sawyer registration iframe, so the roster now points straight at the Sawyer schedules page (browser fetch). Programs are hosted at Frontier Games, 724 Manhattan Ave, Greenpoint (stated per-listing in the schedule), plus non-Greenpoint school sites (PS290 Ridgewood — skip) and online classes (not mappable). First real read 2026-07-27: all offerings are fall-semester kids registrations (Sep starts, $470–$1,425) — carded as nyplays-fall-registration (subscription); no dated in-window events yet. CHANNEL: web-only — no newsletter found in the mailbox (2026-07-27).
